summary: Delete older-Core compatibility gates for pool features (pool-join-v1, pool-maintenance-v1, pool-authority-replica-v2, pool-authority-transfer-v1, pool-witness-v1, pool-host-fencing-v1, pool-watchdog-cluster-v1, pool-vm-placement-v1, pool-resource-removal-v1): their constants, advertisement, Controller 409 refusals, Core 404/405 'upgrade it' peer mappings, projection *_supported fields, the replica 'unsupported' state, the join-candidate capability row and the UI upgrade notes. Also delete the BUG-0707 blank-host policy Run now replay binding and the redundant startup catalog receipt reconcile, and restore the exported catalog rebuild used by nex-core-local. API impact: changed contract.

guide.reason: Operator prerequisites and troubleshooting entries that named the removed capabilities and upgrade refusals are gone; the host fencing and fencing-readiness 'not reported' text no longer tells the operator to upgrade.

api.reason: Removed from GET /api/v1/pools/{id}/members: maintenance_supported, replica_supported, transfer_supported, host_fencing_supported, per-member transfer_supported and replica state 'unsupported'; removed the 'capability' join-candidate row. Removed the capability 409s on pool join, maintenance, master change/cancel/eject, promotion preflight/promote, fence profile, BMC probe/provisioning, host fencing, witness registration, VM create/update placement, network remove/rename and ISO remove (a bodyless succeeded-ISO DELETE is now 400 invalid JSON request). Core no longer maps a peer 404/405 to an 'upgrade it' message, and pool_requests go to every protocol v2 report. Not in production: no Controller/Core version compatibility is kept.

roadmap.reason: Legacy compatibility removal under the 2026-09-29 no-production owner decision.

state.reason: No durable state is added or moved; only compatibility checks and projection fields derived from advertised capabilities are removed.

verification.method: Controller, agent, protocol and vmhost Go tests (focused, then go test ./internal/... once), web tsc and npm test, tests.test_api_contract, generate_api.py --check.
verification.limits: No browser walkthrough or lab run; the integration harness edits (managed_vm_browser.py, website_controller_captures.py, ui-review.json) were only syntax-checked.
